label: def:yekutieli-lifting-condition
title: Quantum Lifting Condition
html:
Definition. Quantum Lifting Condition

Let \mathbf{C} be an R-linear rigid monoidal category. Let

  1  \longrightarrow  \mathcal{B}
   \longrightarrow  \mathfrak{G}'
   \longrightarrow  \mathfrak{G}
   \longrightarrow  1

be a central extension of gerbes on a site \mathcal{S}, banded by an abelian sheaf \mathcal{B}. We say that \mathbf{C} satisfies the Quantum Lifting Condition with respect to (\mathfrak{G}', \mathfrak{G}, \mathcal{B}) if, for every object x \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathfrak{G}), the obstruction to lifting x to an object x' \in \mathrm{Ob}(\mathfrak{G}') is classified by a single cohomology class

  \kappa(x)  \in  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}),

and x admits a lift if and only if \kappa(x) = 0.

This is the categorical form of the gerbe central-extension obstruction of Yekutieli [yekutieli2010]; we adopt the name Quantum Lifting Condition to emphasise its role in specialising the categorical substrate.
